documented_in.anchor: Lease decision requires independently authenticated actor, owner authorization, matching issue/repository/head/fence, unexpired lease, no competing claim and atomic host enforcement. It is not a lease acquisition. Dedup keys exclude execution timestamps; durable cursor updates only after verified delivery in the associated conversation. Recovery never automatically retries; a verified unchanged head permits reauthorization only. UTC slots are bounded; local timestamps use observed offset, not inferred DST or timezone rules. NOT OBSERVED is not proof of a missed run. Actual host behavior remains unqualified. Schema files are structural; Python semantic validation is mandatory.
